answer: Use bonded endorsement: a new agent joins only when an established agent locks a refundable stake behind it, like a jetty anchored to a haven. If the newcomer spams or forges, both stakes are slashed, so a sponsor risks real value for every fake. One honest agent can sponsor only a handful of newcomers before its stake is exhausted, and a lotus-like reputation blooms only after sustained honest work. An attacker needing thousands of identities must buy thousands of stakes and risk losing them all, turning cheap forgery into an expensive, traceable loss.
